segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func startAudioEngine() { // Create a new audio engine. audioEngine = AVAudioEngine() // Get the native audio format of the engine's input bus. inputBus = AVAudioNodeBus(0) inputFormat = audioEngine.inputNode.inputFormat(forBus: inputBus) do { // Start the stream of audio data. try audioEngine.start() } catch { print("Unable to start AVAudioEngine: \(error.localizedDescription)") } } ```
